J0lA8DKxTp3JXWCT.description:
Trigger The anchored dimensional would be hit by a melee or ranged Strike

Requirements The anchored dimensional is aware of the attack and is not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against them

Effect The anchored dimensional spins their body, causing the stabilization ring to rotate into the way of the attack. The triggering Strike's damage is dealt to the stabilization ring, rather than the anchored dimensional. All other effects of the Strike affect the anchored dimensional.
J0lA8DKxTp3JXWCT.name: Opportunistic Rotation

XPCkoxOB1keStlw5.description: The anchored dimensional lashes out in all directions, making a spined lash Strike against each adjacent enemy. Each attack counts toward their multiple attack penalty, but they don't increase their penalty until all these attacks have been made.
XPCkoxOB1keStlw5.name: Frenetic Thrash

oBwbVGDH9G0p3y9n.description: An anchored dimensional is a creature from between realities forced to adopt a physical, three-dimensional form via a magitech device called a stabilization ring. The stabilization ring uses the anchored dimensional's AC and saving throws, but it has hardness 3, HP 20 (BT 10). When the stabilization ring is broken, the anchored dimensional gains concealment. When the stabilization ring is destroyed, the dimensional is freed, returning home to the incomprehensible space between realities.
oBwbVGDH9G0p3y9n.name: Stabilization Ring

vljXyh1cHVJGwrxm.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The anchored dimensional takes advantage of its tenuous relationship with space and time to outmaneuver threats. The anchored dimensional teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 15 feet.
vljXyh1cHVJGwrxm.name: Slip Through Space

Antigravity Swell.description: The beyond terror's entrance into reality negates gravity in a localized area, resembling the zero-g vacuum of space.
Antigravity Swell.hazardDisable: @Check[arcana|dc:13] or @Check[occultism|dc:13] (trained) to temporarily counter the hazard's gravitational influence, preventing it from changing the gravity level on its next turn. The hazard is permanently disabled when the beyond terror is defeated.
Antigravity Swell.hazardReset: The hazard doesn't reset once the beyond terror is defeated.
Antigravity Swell.hazardRoutine: (1 action) On each of the hazard's turns, gravity in its affected area (indicated by a dotted line on the map) alters by one step, going from normal to low on turn 1 and low to zero on turn 2. From turn 3 onward, the area shifts between zero and low gravity on each alternating turn, and continues to do so until the hazard is disabled.
Antigravity Swell.name: Antigravity Swell

FMPjVAPYmdDBB5rs.description:
The shobhad longrifle is a firearm with a long, rifled barrel. Often mounted with a multi-lensed scope for targeting at an array of ranges and a chambering mechanism that can adjust the speed and penetrating power of each shot, it's the preferred weapon of many shobhad warriors.

Shobhad longrifles are equipped with a built-in silencer so they make no more noise than a crossbow when fired.

A shobhad longrifle is a martial weapon.
FMPjVAPYmdDBB5rs.name: Shobhad Longrifle

cBYFByPLNfUZyxT5.description: While she's on Akiton, Aruk automatically succeeds at Survival checks to [[/act track]] made during exploration mode.
cBYFByPLNfUZyxT5.name: World-Blessed Tracker

faL5Wvi6rh3wF8GO.description: Aruk transfers up to @Damage[10[healing]] Hit Points from her vitality network to a bonded creature she can sense within 60 feet. This works on creatures with void healing as though this action had the void trait.
faL5Wvi6rh3wF8GO.name: Transfer Vitality

kT6fbRcn5FPhEsbz.description: Aruk has a vitality network they share with up to 10 bonded allies. This network can store a maximum of @Damage[14[healing]] Hit Points, begins combat full, and regains @Damage[4[healing]] Hit Points per round.
kT6fbRcn5FPhEsbz.name: Vitality Network

6ySQrJhkrlPOLBku.description: Creatures Swallowed Whole by the beyond terror are subjected to the constant mental assault of an entire world's collective, crushing existential fear. They have 2 fewer rounds before they begin suffocating, and after their escape, they are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 round as their mind struggles to readjust after the ordeal.
6ySQrJhkrlPOLBku.name: Horrors Beyond

MXL34uaiVWCvDQNJ.description: As an entity of pure fear, the beyond terror cannot comprehend emotions outside its sphere of influence. When attempting Will saves against spells or effects with the emotion trait that deal with any emotion other than fear, the beyond terror treats its saving throw result as one step worse than what it rolls.
MXL34uaiVWCvDQNJ.name: Inconceivable Feelings

Sghosw4RWMBrabIG.description:
The beyond terror releases a psychic scream of horror that rings through every conscious mind in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30], dealing @Damage[3d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage. All thinking creatures within range must attempt a @Check[will|dc:15] save. The beyond terror cannot use Psychic Scream again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Psychic Scream]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
Sghosw4RWMBrabIG.name: Psychic Scream

cgqqob6BdWvBykAx.description: The beyond terror senses a creature's mental activity as a precise sense within the listed range; it cannot sense mindless creatures with thoughtsense.
cgqqob6BdWvBykAx.name: Thoughtsense

gAj8SDMe3PAsa5zd.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Bo-Shek has 35 Hit Points or less

Effect Bo-Shek howls a defiant roar and the Beasts of Bo respond in kind. He gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last 1 minute. As long as he has temporary Hit Points remaining, he deals an additional 1d6 precision damage with his melee Strikes.
gAj8SDMe3PAsa5zd.name: Rallied by the Beasts

vNh0i1Py2NNHXKae.description: If Bo-Shek dealt damage to a creature with his painglaive while it was boosted, he additionally knocks the target back 10 feet, or 20 feet on a critical hit.
vNh0i1Py2NNHXKae.name: Supercharged Swing

Bumper Bridge.description: The bumpers on the bridge push forward, attempting to knock competitors into the river.
Bumper Bridge.hazardRoutine: (3 actions) The bumper bridge attempts to [[/act shove]] all creatures on the bridge into the river with an Athletics bonus of [[/gmr 1d20+9 #Athletics]]{+9} (no multiple attack penalty).
Bumper Bridge.name: Bumper Bridge

zMCruzS7vHwKGcug.description: A Burnt Circle conspirator spouts some of their nihilistic teachings to a creature within 30 feet. They attempt a [[/act demoralize skill=occultism]] check using Occultism in place of Intimidation.
zMCruzS7vHwKGcug.name: Nihilistic Pronouncement

6sMaaPWEHnh3qKiH.description:
Trigger The cephalaspis corpse is the target of a physical ranged attack

Effect The cephalaspis corpse deflects the attack with the armored plates covering its head, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
6sMaaPWEHnh3qKiH.name: Armored Deflection

GUnPRUkd7otEG2fB.description:
Requirements The cephalaspis corpse has a Medium or smaller creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Effect The cephalaspis corpse attempts an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} the grabbed creature, with the following results.

Critical Success The cephalaspis corpse Flies 30 feet straight up and then drops the creature, causing it to fall.

Success As critical success, but only 20 feet.

Failure No effect.

Critical Failure The creature is no longer grabbed.
GUnPRUkd7otEG2fB.name: Pummeling Loop

tChsmijby1Hg2d2b.description: The cephalaspis corpse Strides twice, then makes an armored crest Strike. A Medium or smaller creature struck by this attack must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:15] save or be automatically Shoved back 5 feet and knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} by the force of the blow.
tChsmijby1Hg2d2b.name: Cephalaspis Charge

Moga6A0S9DerLsrk.description: Chendre can extend the range of her spells. If the next action she uses is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet.
Moga6A0S9DerLsrk.name: Reach Spell

9Br83vm6jVMDIT7l.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Nanites implanted in the converted khefak's body repair its wounds, restoring @Damage[2d6[healing]] Hit Points.
9Br83vm6jVMDIT7l.name: Nanite Repair

B5avTTL0yQnwsYEy.description:
Requirements The converted khefak hit with a mandible Strike on its most recent action this turn

Effect The converted khefak quickly rotates the jagged serrations along its mandibles, dealing @Damage[1d10[slashing]] damage to the creature it hit with its mandible Strike.
B5avTTL0yQnwsYEy.name: Trenching Teeth

wq5SfvOgvExZmzYa.description: A khefak chews on an unattended object to feed, dealing @Damage[4[piercing]] damage every 10 minutes to the object. This damage ignores 10 points of Hardness. If a khefak doesn't spend at least 1 hour Gnawing Scrap per day, it begins to starve until it spends 10 minutes Gnawing Scrap.
wq5SfvOgvExZmzYa.name: Gnaw Scrap

FZWvbuz4COfV5djR.description: The converted local taps into magic of their mutation, amplifying their power. Their monstrous claw Strikes deal an additional 1d6 acid damage until the start of their next turn.
FZWvbuz4COfV5djR.name: Enhance Mutation

ft6a6pkvNINge1E0.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The converted local rushes forward at supernatural speed. They Stride twice.
ft6a6pkvNINge1E0.name: Supernatural Dash

Converted Yearling Arabuk.description:
Yearling arabuks collect in glarings. They're abandoned by their mothers days after birth, then adopted by a mature arabuk that raises them as a group.

Those traveling through Akiton's Winterlands risk stumbling on its apex predator: the carnivorous arabuk.

KpL7ANmYnOLAMS91.description: The arabuk Strides twice with a +10-foot circumstance bonus to Speed, ignoring difficult terrain caused by ice, snow, or other arctic conditions.
KpL7ANmYnOLAMS91.name: Glacial Stride

OMq8Py3IrBbajrWz.description: The arabuk's antlers reverberate a discordant anthem, dealing @Damage[2d4[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage to all non-arabuk creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15]. Any other arabuks within 60 feet can shake their antlers to add their harmonics to this chorus as a reaction. For each arabuk that does, the area of Harmonic Hum increases by 15 feet, to a maximum of a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60].
OMq8Py3IrBbajrWz.name: Harmonic Hum

cJIGGar4N1oTh41n.description: Snow doesn't impair a yearling arabuk's vision; it ignores @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} from snowfall.
cJIGGar4N1oTh41n.name: Snow Vision

Converted Yearling Arabuk.name: Converted Yearling Arabuk

Corpse Fleet Infantry.description:
The Corpse Fleet's rank and file infantry are trained to work as a unit.

The Corpse Fleet is an army made up of undead supremacists who refuse to bow to the will of the living. Founded by defectors from the Eoxian navy, the Corpse Fleet aims to shatter Pact Worlds unity and liberate Eox from the influence of the living and those bone sages who sided with them. Unyielding and utterly ruthless, the Corpse Fleet deals in death and destruction, feeding on the living and exploiting the dead.

4tc8In6JzRT2PZ3N.description:
Trigger An adjacent ally moves away from the Corpse Fleet infantry

Effect The Corpse Fleet infantry Strides up to half their Speed. They must move in the same direction as the triggering ally.
4tc8In6JzRT2PZ3N.name: Coordinated Shuffle

zDhm0Ul1KIbLhKYB.description: The Corpse Fleet infantry's ranged Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage when the Corpse Fleet infantry is within the first range increment of at least one other member of the Corpse Fleet wielding a ranged weapon.
zDhm0Ul1KIbLhKYB.name: Fusillade

Corpse Fleet Infantry.name: Corpse Fleet Infantry

IbXtfmCp6YNuKXgr.description: The gliding bear Strides up to double its Speed in a straight line, Climbing and Leaping over any obstacles in its way. At the end of this movement, it can attempt a melee Strike. On a hit, it additionally knocks the target @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
IbXtfmCp6YNuKXgr.name: Mauling Rush

pv31O1VIfsF8qeP4.description:
Trigger The gliding bear is dealt damage

Effect One of the gliding bear's pustules pops, spraying putrid fluid in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. All creatures in the area become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:15|basic] save.
pv31O1VIfsF8qeP4.name: Burst Pustule

Y0iB7bNuxPgruGl0.description: The cy-boar Strides twice and then makes a tusk Strike. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack roll.
Y0iB7bNuxPgruGl0.name: Boar Charge

UCwR3xXa3KJPVqHC.description: A d-vee maintains an altitude of six inches above other surfaces, such as ground and water. If driven off a high surface, the d-vee loses 20 feet of altitude per round, landing without harm to the d-vee or its pilot and passengers.
UCwR3xXa3KJPVqHC.name: Hover

mdyo8hK5RW8jdmKg.description: A d-vee is equipped with automated navigation, which helps pilots drive the vehicle through Akiton's harsh environment. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Piloting checks to pilot a d-vee. You can attempt any Piloting skill check with a d-vee untrained, using your level as your proficiency bonus.
mdyo8hK5RW8jdmKg.name: Auto-Nav

Despair Cannon.description: A magical cannon fires psychic beams of despair at intruders.
Despair Cannon.hazardDisable: @Check[arcana|dc:21] (trained) or @Check[occultism|dc:21] (trained) to diffuse the psychic energy, @Check[thievery|dc:19] (trained) to disable the cannon, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 19) to counteract the cannon's magical components
Despair Cannon.hazardRoutine: (3 actions) The trap makes three despair beam Strikes against creatures in range.
Despair Cannon.name: Despair Cannon

oGdimHbLqpprEUIR.description: The drillworm burrows up to its Speed and then emerges onto the surface. All creatures adjacent to it when it ends its movement must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:13] save or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
oGdimHbLqpprEUIR.name: Bursting Rubble

RNEZE3Cu2MIoAgid.description:
Frequency once per round

Trigger Elovai is targeted by a ranged Strike or ranged spell attack

Requirements Elovai is aware of the attack and not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against it

Effect Elovai opens a faceted rift in space in the path of the projectile. Elovai gains a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, she opens a matching rift near another creature within 60 feet of her and makes a ranged spell attack against that creature. Resolve the original attack or spell against the chosen creature based on the results of Elovai's spell attack.
RNEZE3Cu2MIoAgid.name: Reality Shunt

aErLeJPFuW7h3NZv.description:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
aErLeJPFuW7h3NZv.name: See the Unseen (Constant)

nMovn5eLRFhXpWzN.description: 30 feet. The facets of Elovai's form reflect worrying glimpses of strange realities degrading away to nothing. A creature that can see who enters or begins its turn within the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. If it fails, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on critical failure). A creature that succeeds on this save becomes immune to this aura for 1 hour.
nMovn5eLRFhXpWzN.name: Disconcerting Reflections

yimYXXVQzgIyNU97.description: Elovai manipulates space in higher dimensions to attack from unexpected directions. If her next action is to cast a spell with an area, range, or target, the spell manifests from one of her allies within 100 feet instead of herself. She uses the ally's space to determine the spell's source, range, and area of effect, but line of sight and line of effect must be met by both Elovai and her selected ally when the spell is cast.
yimYXXVQzgIyNU97.name: Higher Dimensional Geometry

Elovai's Interference.description: Elovai laughs maniacally as the whole psychic storm bends to her will.
Elovai's Interference.hazardDisable: @Check[arcana|dc:20] (trained) or @Check[occultism|dc:20] (trained) to magically disrupt Elovai's control, @Check[nature|dc:21] (expert), @Check[religion|dc:21] (expert), @Check[survival|dc:21] (expert), or @Check[thievery|dc:21] (trained) to understand and unravel the underpinnings of the psychic storm, or @Check[will|dc:23] save to disbelieve Elovai's illusions; three total successes are required to disable the hazard.
Elovai's Interference.hazardRoutine: (3 actions) The hazard uses Platform Dissolution, then alternates between using either False Manifestation or Malevolent Wind.
Elovai's Interference.name: Elovai's Interference

Exploding Fruit Trap.description: A makeshift catapult launches a dozen twi-lw fruits at all creatures in a wide area when a creature enters a selected @Template[square|distance:5].
Exploding Fruit Trap.hazardDisable: @Check[survival|dc:14] or @Check[thievery|dc:14] to disable the triggering pressure plate.
Exploding Fruit Trap.name: Exploding Fruit Trap

fzBwBZEB8PPBVoTj.description:
Trigger The facet guardian is damaged by an attack with the light trait or a weapon from the laser group

Effect The facet guardian reflexively positions its facets to scatter the light in all directions. It gains resistance 5 to the triggering damage and creatures adjacent to the facet guardian take damage equal to the amount of damage resisted this way (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]).
fzBwBZEB8PPBVoTj.name: Scatter Light

iLSbvA4ySWv2JmxZ.description: When the facet guardian critically succeeds on a focused reflection Strike, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
iLSbvA4ySWv2JmxZ.name: Dazzling Reflection

jERkiSsIUnQegewH.description: The facet guardian dashes forward quickly, sliding on the knife-edge of one of its facets. It moves up to its Speed and makes one mirror's edge Strike against any number of creatures it passes adjacent to during its movement. These attacks contribute to the facet guardian's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty does not increase until all attacks are complete.
jERkiSsIUnQegewH.name: Edge Skate

sptNG7yVCKDcGuCA.description: The facet guardian quickly unfolds for storage against a flat surface or refolds itself into humanoid shape. The surface must be flat and large enough to contain the guardian in its unfolded state, at least 5 feet by 10 feet, though it can be oriented in any direction. When in unfolded form, the facet guardian cannot take any action except Flat-Pack to refold, and its Deception DC to Impersonate an inanimate mural increase to DC 22.
sptNG7yVCKDcGuCA.name: Flat-Pack

Fire Wisp.description:
Fire wisps are sizzling spheres of flame and ash, perpetually crackling and shimmering with heat. They're carefree, boisterous, and quick to action—sometimes recklessly so.

Wisps are tiny elemental beings that emerged during the creation of the Elemental Planes. The first wisps roamed the Inner Sphere in shifting symphonies that traded members with their every meeting. These symphonies of free wisps created music out of their combined resonances, but when the wicked Elemental Lords realized the value of the wisps' resonance, they captured whole symphonies for use as servants.

Wisps attune to each other and to those they surround themselves with. This attunement makes them naturally supportive allies. Free wisps still roam the Inner Sphere and the Universe, but they're usually shy and hide themselves from strangers. However, they happily offer their service to those who show them kindness. They especially find themselves drawn to spellcasters who practice elemental magic; these wisps usually watch from afar but sometimes approach those who seem safe to become familiars or comrades.

Free wisps who find one another become close almost immediately. They get especially excited when they find wisps of elements other than their own, showing none of the animosity sometimes exhibited between elementals of different planes. Instead, they join in an excited dance, emitting resonances that faintly echo the symphonies of ancient days.

8ouYwNI7s6yxF3ca.description: The fire wisp ignores the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke.
8ouYwNI7s6yxF3ca.name: Smoke Vision

F4EVIzNsRZf5yXqZ.description:
30 feet. All wisps vibrate at a frequency attuned to their element, resonating with and empowering all creatures and effects sharing that trait.

A creature in the area gains a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for effects with the fire trait; a creature with the elemental and fire traits gains this bonus to all attack and damage rolls.
F4EVIzNsRZf5yXqZ.name: Resonance

hc1Yo8IhekNVsQWZ.description:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet that benefited from the wisp's resonance in the last hour is targeted by an attack

Effect The wisp detonates themself in an elemental explosion. This grants temporary Hit Points equal to half the wisp's current Hit Points to allies within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} who have benefited from the wisp's resonance in the last hour. These temporary Hit Points last 1 hour.

A wisp that uses this reaction is permanently destroyed, and they can be restored by only a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual or similarly powerful effect. If an ability would prevent the wisp's destruction (for instance, if the wisp is summoned and would merely be dismissed), Accord Essence has no effect.
hc1Yo8IhekNVsQWZ.name: Accord Essence

ktRcEmzMFW1LP1bz.description: When a fire wisp rolls a critical failure on a check to Aid, they get a failure instead, and when they roll a success, they get a critical success instead.
ktRcEmzMFW1LP1bz.name: In Concert

Fire Wisp.name: Fire Wisp

q2d0bjB8Dn3mpZM3.description:
@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.zDJS8E66UI0himqV]{Thunderstrike}

These latticed gemstones are suspended in a silicon casing and encoded with the magical script necessary to cast a single, specific spell. Casting a spell from a spell gem requires holding the gem in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell must be of your spellcasting tradition. The spell in a spell gem can be cast only once, and the spell gem is destroyed as part of the casting. Spell gems can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.
q2d0bjB8Dn3mpZM3.name: Spell Gem of Thunderstrike (Rank 1)

CAOjznkp9qfOiF05.description: The dragonkin exhales a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] of fire that deals @Damage[2d4[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic] save). They can't use Dragonkin Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Dragonkin Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.
CAOjznkp9qfOiF05.name: Dragonkin Breath

dDpbhwxNPpWrU3n7.description: The creature can sense the electric field given off by living creatures, allowing them to precisely target living creatures without using visual means.
dDpbhwxNPpWrU3n7.name: Electrolocation

k8DHK6NNbBcwEWcO.description: The girendal Leaps up to its Speed, and then makes an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] a target within reach of its tentacles. On a critical success the target is additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
k8DHK6NNbBcwEWcO.name: Grasping Leap

K3V0T0IojnOjCa2G.description: Gremmik Integrated can have up to 4 creatures @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} at the same time, each with a different leg.
K3V0T0IojnOjCa2G.name: Manifold Hold

fccWY17P2UHyDvop.description: Gremmik Integrated makes a leg Strike against each enemy within reach, up to a maximum of eight targets. He takes a –2 circumstance penalty on these attacks, but his multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after these attacks are complete. He can't Grab with any leg Strikes made this way.
fccWY17P2UHyDvop.name: Too Many Legs!

sprawoN6zBGMnHlV.description: Gremmik Integrated can communicate wirelessly with Elovai while within the Wreck of the Returned.
sprawoN6zBGMnHlV.name: Neural Integration

Heat Vents.description: Gremmik Integrated blasts the four 10-foot square grates with steam from underneath, using the water that cools the servers.
Heat Vents.hazardDisable: @Check[crafting|dc:18] or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:18] to cover the vents or @Check[thievery|dc:20] to Disable the mechanics; four total successes are required as each grate must be disabled. Once a grate is disabled, it no longer deals damage.
Heat Vents.hazardRoutine: All creatures in or above the four 10-foot square vents are dealt @Damage[4d4[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|options:area-effect] save)
Heat Vents.name: Heat Vents

Holographic Display.description: Gremmik Integrated uses the holographic display from the center platform to distract and confuse one PC
Holographic Display.hazardDisable: @Check[computers|dc:18] to reprogram the display or @Check[thievery|dc:20] to turn it off entirely; three total successes are required.
Holographic Display.hazardRoutine:
The holographic display targets one creature within 20 feet of the platform, quickly displaying and changing graphs, logos, and videos. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20|options:inflicts:off-guard,inflicts:dazzled] save, with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the holographic display and is immune to its effects.

Reality Cyclone.description: A damaged device unleashes a blast of magical energy, which coalesces into a cyclone that degrades reality.
Reality Cyclone.hazardDisable: @Check[arcana|dc:17] or @Check[nature|dc:17] (trained) to diffuse magical energy, @Check[crafting|dc:18] or @Check[computers|dc:18] (trained) to shut down the device, @Check[occultism|dc:17] to stabilize reality, @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to destabilize the cyclone, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the cyclone
Reality Cyclone.hazardRoutine: (2 actions) The cyclone moves up to 30 feet toward the nearest living creature, then churns in place, degrading reality. All living creatures within 10 feet of the cyclone are dealt @Damage[1d8[acid]] damage, or @Damage[2d8[acid]] damage if the cyclone is in their space (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save).
Reality Cyclone.name: Reality Cyclone

Reality Warp.description: Reality glitches, causing one of the camp's five areas to jump backward and forward in time, buildings and people alike dissolving in the temporal chaos.
Reality Warp.hazardDisable: @Check[arcana|dc:18], @Check[nature|dc:18], @Check[occultism|dc:18], or @Check[religion|dc:18] (trained) to magically reinforce Akiton's reality, or @Check[intimidation|dc:19] (trained) to impose your will on the reality warp; must be in the hazard's active area to Disable it.
Reality Warp.hazardRoutine: (2 actions) With its first action, reality warps in the hazard's active area, dealing @Damage[(1d10+6)[force]] damage to all creatures in that area (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save). With its second action, the active hazard moves to a different area, determined randomly. Any creatures in this new active area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. On a failure, they are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as they try to process the changing reality; on a critical failure, they are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.
Reality Warp.name: Reality Warp

Ok35vLXn9cDcowo5.description: A khefak chews on an unattended object to feed, dealing @Damage[4[piercing]] damage every 10 minutes to the object. This damage ignores 10 points of Hardness. If a khefak doesn't spend at least 1 hour Gnawing Scrap per day, it begins to starve until it spends 10 minutes Gnawing Scrap.
Ok35vLXn9cDcowo5.name: Gnaw Scrap

rzn5YSVdXdb7eaMx.description: The khefak flicks its tail, unleashing a blast of volatile magic that deals @Damage[3d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:line|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save). It can't use Tail Blast again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Tail Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.
rzn5YSVdXdb7eaMx.name: Tail Blast

Reconnection Subroutine.description: The magitech mechanisms that control the works of the complex in the heart of the Wreck attempt to restore the severed connection between the psychic anchors, flooding the area with dangerous energetic tendrils.
Reconnection Subroutine.hazardDisable: @Check[arcana|dc:18], @Check[nature|dc:18], @Check[occultism|dc:18], or @Check[religion|dc:18] to disrupt the flow of magical energy in the floor panels; @Check[crafting|dc:20] or @Check[thievery|dc:20] to disable the magitech floor panels; @Check[computers|dc:22] to deactivate the subroutine (must be attempted at one of the computers in the psychic anchor rooms). Three total successes required.
Reconnection Subroutine.hazardReset: The trap deactivates and resets when all psychic anchors are active. If disabled, this hazard instead resets in 24 hours.
Reconnection Subroutine.hazardRoutine: (2 actions) The hazard makes three probing lash strikes against randomly chosen PCs in area A2 and A5. On the 5th round and every 5 rounds thereafter, the one deactivated psychic anchor becomes active and, if both psychic anchors in that pair are active, the energy beam connecting them is restored. A broken or destroyed psychic anchor can't be activated in this way.
Reconnection Subroutine.name: Reconnection Subroutine

GVdvyazMyqtAP1ii.description:
Trigger An enemy ends a move action adjacent to Rip

Effect Rip attempts to [[/act shove]] the triggering creature. If she would critically fail, she gets a failure instead.
GVdvyazMyqtAP1ii.name: Defensive Shove

yKVakFvy0abotFW9.description: Whenever Rip Auto-Fires her rotolaser, she excludes Tear from the area. Creatures that fail their save against her Auto-Fire are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the beginning of her next turn.
yKVakFvy0abotFW9.name: Pinpoint Fire

LZ95dkTzUzwTppsb.description: A robotic oil can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.
LZ95dkTzUzwTppsb.name: Motion Sense

yH8akb8RbYn6t4bR.description:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The robotic oil sprays fluids in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. All constructs in the area are repaired, regaining @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points. All non-constructs in the area are dealt @Damage[2d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save.
yH8akb8RbYn6t4bR.name: Reparative Spray

Sequence Breaker.description: A hacking probe with built-in anti-tampering countermeasures.
Sequence Breaker.hazardDisable: @Check[thievery|dc:16] (trained) to disable the anti-intrusion sensor, @Check[computers|dc:18] (trained) or @Check[crafting|dc:18] (trained) to cut the power supply, or @Check[athletics|dc:20] to swiftly rip the power-pack out of the device before it can respond.
Sequence Breaker.name: Sequence Breaker

Shobhad Indignation.description: The paintings weep blackness outward until they create shadows from floor to ceiling.
Shobhad Indignation.hazardDisable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:20] (trained) to divert the energy of the spirits against each other, @Check[athletics|dc:18] (trained) to [[/act grapple]] the spirits, or @Check[religion|dc:18] or @Check[occultism|dc:18] (trained) to soothe the restless souls; two successes are required to disable the hazard.
Shobhad Indignation.hazardRoutine:
(1 action) Shadowy hands lunge from the walls to drag down creatures in the room. The hazard attempts an Athletics check with a [[/gmr 1d20+12 #Athletics]]{+12} modifier against the Fortitude DC of up to two different creatures in the room.

Critical Success The target takes @Damage[(2d10+4)[bludgeoning]] damage, is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and is pushed 10 feet toward the nearest wall. It can't breathe or speak until it ends the prone condition.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1d10+4)[bludgeoning]] damage and is pushed 5 feet toward the nearest wall.
Shobhad Indignation.name: Shobhad Indignation

IPPHFvodIVmPffgw.description: Shosodax has forged an intense psychic connection with their reaction breacher, channeling their hatred into every shot fired and wound inflicted. They deal an additional 1d8 mental damage with their reaction breacher (already included in damage) and their reaction breacher gains the magical trait.
IPPHFvodIVmPffgw.name: Psychic Resonance

YevoxrUcYePJsiiZ.description: Shosodax makes two ranged Strikes with their reaction breacher, each at a different target, then Interacts to reload their reaction breacher.
YevoxrUcYePJsiiZ.name: Raider's Assault

Simulation Assault.description: A rapid sequence of dizzying simulations plays throughout the theater.
Simulation Assault.hazardDisable: @Check[arcana|dc:17], @Check[nature|dc:17], @Check[occultism|dc:17], or @Check[religion|dc:17] (trained) to siphon the magical energy, or @Check[thievery|dc:19] (trained) to disrupt the holograms, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 16)
Simulation Assault.hazardRoutine: (1 action) The hazard plays a new simulation each round, forcing all creatures who can sense it to attempt a new save.
Simulation Assault.name: Simulation Assault

3j6NsMt7lRbvpOeG.description:
Large or smaller, wheels, @Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]. After using Trample, the solar parade float can't use Trample again for 2 rounds.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]
3j6NsMt7lRbvpOeG.name: Trample

UCoTnZ4b8LC9dkdS.description: The solar parade float shoots t-shirts at all enemies within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet}. Creatures in the area can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:17|options:area-effect] save. On a failure, the t-shirts wrap around their appendages, imposing a –10 foot circumstance penalty to all their Speeds until the end of their next turn. A creature can end this effect early as a single action with the manipulate trait.
UCoTnZ4b8LC9dkdS.name: T-Shirt Barrage

Sterilization Protocol.description: Nozzles on the walls spray hot water, chemical sanitizers, and superheated air at all creatures entering the U-shaped hall.
Sterilization Protocol.hazardDisable: @Check[computers|dc:14] (trained) to reprogram the system to safe levels, @Check[crafting|dc:14] (trained) to shut off the waterline, or @Check[thievery|dc:13] (trained) to cut power to the hall
Sterilization Protocol.hazardReset: The trap automatically deactivates and resets if there are no creatures in the area.
Sterilization Protocol.hazardRoutine: (2 actions) The trap sprays a powerful stream of superheated water and sanitizer at all creatures in the U-shaped hall, dealing @Damage[1d4[bludgeoning],1d4[fire]]{1d4 bludgeoning damage and 1d4 fire damage} (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save).
Sterilization Protocol.name: Sterilization Protocol

Swinging Log Trap.description: A log hung up in the trees swings down in a wide arc when a creature enters the designated @Template[square|distance:10] area.
Swinging Log Trap.hazardDisable: @Check[survival|dc:14] or @Check[thievery|dc:14] to safely sever the triggering pulleys and ropes.
Swinging Log Trap.name: Swinging Log Trap

1d9MfWTBlFjKHbrp.description: Tade just keeps coming with their pistol fire. They make two ranged Strikes, one with each of their two semi-auto pistols. These strikes must be against different targets.
1d9MfWTBlFjKHbrp.name: Relentless Fire

GJSTcqWWCX6ue8p1.description:
Trigger Tade is dealt damage

Effect Magic surges through Tade's body, automatically reconstructing damaged flesh and muscle. Tade regains @Damage[5[healing]] Hit Points.
GJSTcqWWCX6ue8p1.name: Rapid Reconstruction

U5vaGJ7q8IGzEoi1.description: Tade can communicate wirelessly with nodocites within 200 feet.
U5vaGJ7q8IGzEoi1.name: Networked

spledzF8JwQKIfEi.description:
Requirements Tade is wielding at least one ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait

Effect Tade takes careful aim at a single creature they're aware of, designating it as their mark. Until the end of Tade's turn, their ranged Strikes against their mark using any ranged weapon deal an additional 2d4 precision damage and reduce the circumstance bonus to AC their mark gains from cover by 1. Tade can only have one mark at a time.
spledzF8JwQKIfEi.name: Multi-Weapon Aim

utIPcsJYuNyM5QyS.description: Tade reloads up to two guns they're wielding.
utIPcsJYuNyM5QyS.name: Mass Reload

kKRoUSRntvm2YUQR.description: Tear Leaps or Strides, then Interacts to boost her fangblade. If she ends her movement within reach of an enemy, she makes a fangblade Strike against that creature.
kKRoUSRntvm2YUQR.name: Boosted Assault

Tenderizer Pit.description: Metal caution-taped doors cover a 10-foot deep pit full of dull metal spikes.
Tenderizer Pit.hazardDisable: @Check[thievery|dc:12] to lock or close the trap door
Tenderizer Pit.hazardReset: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.
Tenderizer Pit.name: Tenderizer Pit

0phjKaClcJM1E0V2.description: The Caretaker has a vitality network with a starting and maximum capacity of 22 Hit Points. At the start of each of his turns in combat, his vitality network regains 4 Hit Points. When he Refocuses, his vitality network regains all its Hit Points.
0phjKaClcJM1E0V2.name: Vitality Network

acwk1TdMsDXE5aeR.description: The Caretaker transfers up to @Damage[10[healing]|options:area-damage] Hit Points (minimum 1) from his vitality network to himself or to a creature in his mystic bond he can sense within 60 feet. This works on creatures with void healing as though this action has the void trait. When the Caretaker does, the target's shadow darkens and swells, reducing bright light within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] of the target to dim light until the end of the Caretaker's next turn. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while in this dim light and can use the concealed condition to [[/act hide]].
acwk1TdMsDXE5aeR.name: Transfer Vitality

vbupgqKrPbAuDz03.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The Caretaker is reduced to @Damage[20[healing]|options:area-damage] Hit Points or less

Effect The Caretaker teleports to area B4 in a burst of blazing flame and dense smoke. All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] of where the Caretaker begins and ends this teleportation are dealt @Damage[4d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). The Caretaker regains a number of Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt this way.
vbupgqKrPbAuDz03.name: Fiendish Retreat

yuuZOuAB3Ea2RsXh.description: The Caretaker has forged an unnatural mystic bond between himself and his cybernetic zombies. He always knows the general distance and direction to his zombies, knows their Hit Point totals, and knows if they're conscious or destroyed.
yuuZOuAB3Ea2RsXh.name: Mystic Bond

051PuLaSpaUM4n6y.description:
Trigger The unspooled vestige is hit by a ranged weapon that uses charges and has at least 1 charge remaining in its battery

Effect The unspooled vestige pulls energy from the weapon, causing it to expend an additional charge.
051PuLaSpaUM4n6y.name: Draw Power

0h9gOyR14FpTY68o.description: A unspooled vestige filament becomes entangled with a creature it hits. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}; they're not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but they can't move beyond the range of the unspooled vestige's filament. The unspooled vestige can attempt to [[/act reposition]] each entangled creature with a single Athletics check, which they compare against each creature's Fortitude DC. Doing so only counts as one attempt for the unspooled vestige's multiple attack penalty. The DC to [[/act escape dc=18]] is 18, or a creature can sever the filament with a Strike against AC 15 that deals at least 3 slashing damage. This deals no damage to the unspooled vestige. The unspooled vestige can move without ending the entanglement as long as the creature remains within the filament's range.
0h9gOyR14FpTY68o.name: Entanglement

MVF9DHxKXeHjV01Q.description: The fabric of the creature's reality begins to fray. The unspooled vestige must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] save. On a failure it takes @Damage[1d4[force]] damage, or @Damage[1d6[force]] damage on a critical failure.
MVF9DHxKXeHjV01Q.name: Unspool

qC77y0fTeUuUG9d5.description: At the end of its turn, the unspooled vestige must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a failure, it slips slightly out of reality. It takes @Damage[1d4[force]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the start of its next turn.
qC77y0fTeUuUG9d5.name: Slip Out of Reality

Vile Spray.description: The inflamed walls of this chamber violently contract, squirting out caustic fluids and pus.
Vile Spray.hazardDisable: @Check[medicine|dc:12] (trained) to ease the inflammation, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:13] or @Check[occultism|dc:13] (trained) to psychically soothe the structure; @Check[acrobatics|dc:16] or @Check[stealth|dc:16] to move through the area without triggering its spray (this doesn't disable the hazard).
Vile Spray.name: Vile Spray

17jP54PLTmBe2ZzG.description: 15 feet. A living creature entering or starting its turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save as Vira's command over gravity causes their cells to expand rapidly. On a failure, their skin ruptures, dealing @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage. On a critical failure, they are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. A creature that succeeds on their saving throw is temporarily immune for 1 minute.
17jP54PLTmBe2ZzG.name: Ulcerating Aura

3BKgo6EucgpKV3qw.description: While Vira is in a vacuum or zero-g environment, she gains a fly Speed equal to her Speed.
3BKgo6EucgpKV3qw.name: Untethered Gravity

WF5M302yNvLua7X4.description:
Trigger A creature ends its movement adjacent to Vira

Effect Vira launches a wave of force at the triggering creature. The creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save or be pushed directly back 5 feet, or 10 feet on a critical failure. If the creature is in a vacuum or zero-g environment, they additionally become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}.
WF5M302yNvLua7X4.name: Thrashing Wisps

YBDV3FeIETGbalhU.description:
@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ZxHC7V7HtjUsB8zH]{Blazing Bolt}

These latticed gemstones are suspended in a silicon casing and encoded with the magical script necessary to cast a single, specific spell. Casting a spell from a spell gem requires holding the gem in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell must be of your spellcasting tradition. The spell in a spell gem can be cast only once, and the spell gem is destroyed as part of the casting. Spell gems can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.
YBDV3FeIETGbalhU.name: Spell Gem of Blazing Bolt (Rank 2)

s3uvjQ27jukr24u1.description: Vira's mastery of gravity allows her to augment the impact of her spells. If her next action is to cast a spell that deals damage while she's in a zero-g environment, the target takes an amount of persistent void damage equal to twice the spell's rank.
s3uvjQ27jukr24u1.name: Gravitic Surge

w0yT9j9lkMkzmkek.description:
Requirements The void hemovore's last action was a successful fangs Strike

Effect The void hemovore drinks the creature's blood. The creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] save. On a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, or they increase the value of their drained condition by 1, up to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.
w0yT9j9lkMkzmkek.name: Gorge

Warped Weather.description: An unnatural magical storm appears in the area with a crack of thunder and lightning.
Warped Weather.hazardDisable: @Check[arcana|dc:13], @Check[nature|dc:13], @Check[occultism|dc:13], or @Check[religion|dc:13] (all trained) to overcome the magical anomaly, or @Check[athletics|dc:16], @Check[survival|dc:16], or @Check[thievery|dc:16] to destabilize the hazard's center point; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
Warped Weather.hazardRoutine: (3 actions) The hazard makes three ranged Strikes against PCs, selecting different targets if possible, beginning with those closest to the hazard's center.
Warped Weather.name: Warped Weather

D6ANUDUUCWkvMPYZ.name: +1 to Saves Vs Disease, Mental, Poison, Radiation

rDFDHa2TMo4SwSir.description: If the next action Whisper in the Code takes is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet.
rDFDHa2TMo4SwSir.name: Reach Spell

sVr3EyvFbmnIyxl7.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Whisper in the Code attempts a skill action that takes 3 or fewer actions

Effect Whisper in the Code stimulates their nanites, forcing their body to temporarily increase its efficiency. They gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering skill check. In addition, their circuitry glows, lighting a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] with dim light for 1 round.
sVr3EyvFbmnIyxl7.name: Nanite Surge

eYoVaSXo2pruLXvQ.description:
Requirements Zizenzi's last action was a successful conductive spine Strike

Effect Zizenzi amps up the voltage in their conductive spines, causing immense pain to the injured target. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19|options:inflicts:sickened] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} from the pain (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).
eYoVaSXo2pruLXvQ.name: Amp the Voltage!
